Name: Strade sprite replacement REDRAWN EDITION
Author: BubblegumMurderer
Description:
So, it's been about roughly a year since i uploaded my original sprites, and in the meantime, i got a new computer and worked on my art for a good while. Now the sprites have been updated to sort of try to mimic the main game sprites a bit more, as well as being much more color correct, due to a better source of color selection. The sprites have also been updated to feature a different marriage suit! 

As with the last one, the character and any artwork not done by me on this post belong to Gurobob on tumblr! Please, go support her work!
